description: The LEGACY_OPS Oracle schema (8 tables: T_CLI, T_ORD, T_ORD_ITM, T_PRD, T_CAT, T_EMP, T_DEPT, T_LOG) was inherited from an acquisition. Tables have cryptic names, no primary keys on most tables, no foreign key constraints, and zero documentation. As a Database Architect, reverse-engineer the data model by: (1) adding COMMENT ON TABLE for all 8 tables and COMMENT ON COLUMN for at least 15 columns with meaningful descriptions, (2) adding PRIMARY KEY constraints to tables missing them (T_CLI, T_ORD, T_PRD, T_CAT, T_EMP, T_DEPT), (3) adding FOREIGN KEY constraints for at least 3 relationships (e.g., T_ORD.CLI_ID→T_CLI, T_ORD_ITM.ORD_ID→T_ORD, T_PRD.CAT_ID→T_CAT), and (4) exporting a schema analysis report to /home/ga/Documents/exports/legacy_ops_analysis.txt documenting what each table represents and the relationships identified. Connect as legacy_ops/LegacyOps2024 or system/OraclePassword123.
